methodological_rigor.justification: Small cohort study (sample size from title unclear but likely <100 based on typical CTC studies). Retrospective design. No external validation cohort. Statistical methods minimally described in abstract. CTC analysis methodology not detailed. Power analysis absent. Limited methodological rigor.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Addresses prognostically relevant question of recurrence prediction in HCC post-curative resection. CTC-based biomarkers have potential clinical relevance but require validation in larger prospective cohorts before clinical implementation.

reporting_quality.justification: Abstract provides limited methodological detail. No access to full paper evident. CTC methods not described. TRIPOD adherence unclear. Statistical methods absent from abstract. Data availability not stated.

novelty_literature.justification: Novel combination of CTC and inflammatory biomarkers (ALRI score) for HCC recurrence prediction. Mechanistic combination of cellular and systemic immune markers has merit but requires validation.

writing_presentation.justification: Likely clearly written (based on abstract) but cannot fully assess without reading full manuscript. Abstract appropriately structured.

key_strengths: Novel combination of CTC enumeration with inflammatory biomarkers for prognostication
key_concerns: Small sample size without external validation; exploratory findings only
Limited methodological detail in abstract; full manuscript assessment needed
No power analysis or sample size justification
CTC analysis and ALRI scoring methodology unclear from available information
chief_reviewer.rationale: Small exploratory study with novel biomarker combination but insufficient validation. Tier 4 with major revisions: requires larger prospective multicenter cohort and external validation.
